newsitem.title: INDIA: India's '96/97 foodgrain output seen at 194.80 mt.
newsitem.headline: India's '96/97 foodgrain output seen at 194.80 mt.

text.p: The Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE), an independent think-tank, said on Tuesday it estimated India's total foodgrain production in 1996/97 (April/March) at 194.80 million tonnes, up from the previous year's 185 million.
In its April review of the economy, released on Tuesday, CMIE estimated the kharif or winter foodgrain production at 103.4 million tonnes and the rabi or summer crop at 91.4 million.
The CMIE figure is higher than the official estimates of the agriculture ministry at 192.1 million tonnes comprising 103.1 million of kharif and 89 million of rabi crops.
CMIE forecast, despite unseasonal rains and hailstorms, wheat production in 1996/97 at 64.7 million tonnes, up from 62.6 million in the previous year.
CMIE estimated the overall agricultural growth in 1996/97 at 4.2 percent compared to a negative growth of 0.1 percent in the previous year.
